knowledge:
- key_parameters: scale_tpm=Logical indicating whether to scale the TPM matrix to 1e6 per cell (default TRUE) ;; filter_genes=Logical indicating whether to remove genes with zero expression across all cells ;; variance_cutoff=Numeric value to filter out genes with expression variance below this threshold ;; type_abundance_cutoff=Numeric value to remove cells belonging to cell types with abundance below this threshold ;; scenario=The simulation scenario to use ("even", "random", "mirror_db", "weighted", "pure", "custom") ;; scaling_factor=The method to model mRNA bias ("NONE", "epic", "quantiseq", "custom", "read_number", "expressed_genes", "spike_in", "census", or a custom annotation column) ;; ncells=Number of cells to include in each simulated sample ;; nsamples=Total number of simulated samples to generate ;; total_read_counts=Target sequencing depth applied to the counts matrix ;; whitelist=Vector of cell types to exclusively include in the simulation ;; blacklist=Vector of cell types to exclude from the simulation ;; balance_uniform_mirror_scenario=Numeric value to add slight variation to "even" or "mirror_db" fractions (default 0.01, set to 0 for exact fractions)
- alternatives: sfaira database can be used as an alternative to local single-cell datasets for public data integration.
- when_to_use: Use when you need to generate in silico gold-standard pseudo-bulk RNA-seq datasets with known, fine-grained cell-type fractions to evaluate or benchmark deconvolution algorithms, especially when testing the impact of cell-type-specific mRNA bias.
- pitfalls: Cell-type annotation names in the dataset must match the scaling factor names 1:1 (e.g., for EPIC or quanTIseq); otherwise, they remain unscaled or get scaled incorrectly. Providing raw count data is mandatory. If using h5ad files, cells can be in obs or var layers; setting cells_in_obs incorrectly will lead to wrong matrix orientation. Census scaling factor should ideally be applied to TPM/FPKM normalized data, though it can run on raw counts.

workflows.name: custom_data_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate pseudo-bulk RNA-seq data from custom single-cell count matrices or Seurat objects with controlled cell-type fractions and mRNA bias scaling.
input: annotation_dataframe (data frame with ID and cell_type columns)
seurat_obj (optional Seurat object containing single-cell data)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a SimBu dataset using dataset() or dataset_seurat() ;; 2. Optionally merge multiple datasets using dataset_merge() ;; 3. Simulate pseudo-bulk samples using simulate_bulk() ;; 4. Optionally merge simulations using merge_simulations() ;; 5. Plot the simulation results using plot_simulation()
workflows.code:
ds <- SimBu :: dataset ( annotation = annotation, count_matrix = counts, tpm_matrix = tpm, name = "test_dataset" )
ds_seurat <- SimBu::dataset_seurat( seurat_obj = seurat_obj, counts_layer = "counts", cell_id_col = "ID", cell_type_col = "cell_type", tpm_layer = "data", name = "seurat_dataset" )
ds_multiple <- SimBu::dataset_merge( dataset_list = list(ds_seurat, ds), name = "ds_multiple" )
simulation <- SimBu :: simulate_bulk ( data = ds, scenario = "random" , scaling_factor = "NONE" , ncells = 100 , nsamples = 10 , BPPARAM = BiocParallel :: MulticoreParam ( workers = 4 ), run_parallel = TRUE )
utils :: head (SummarizedExperiment :: assays (simulation $ bulk)[["bulk_counts"]])
utils :: head (SummarizedExperiment :: assays (simulation $ bulk)[["bulk_tpm"]])
merged_simulations <- SimBu :: merge_simulations ( list (simulation, simulation2))
SimBu :: plot_simulation ( simulation = merged_simulations)

workflows.name: sfaira_public_data_simulation
workflows.intent: Integrate public single-cell datasets from the sfaira database to simulate pseudo-bulk RNA-seq data.
input: None (data is downloaded automatically from sfaira based on organism and tissue queries)
workflows.stages: 1. Set up the sfaira environment using setup_sfaira() ;; 2. Query and download datasets using dataset_sfaira_multiple() or dataset_sfaira() ;; 3. Simulate bulk data using simulate_bulk()
workflows.code:
setup_list <- SimBu :: setup_sfaira ( basedir = tempdir ())
ds_pancrease <- SimBu :: dataset_sfaira_multiple ( sfaira_setup = setup_list, organisms = "Homo sapiens" , tissues = "pancreas" , name = "human_pancreas" )
all_datasets <- SimBu :: sfaira_overview ( setup_list = setup_list)
SimBu :: dataset_sfaira ( sfaira_id = "homosapiens_lungparenchyma_2019_10x3v2_madissoon_001_10.1186/s13059-019-1906-x" , sfaira_setup = setup_list, name = "dataset_by_id" )
